name: baltic-porter
description: Skills and guard hooks for repositories that generate Scala 3 sources from Java with the Baltic Porter engine (sge, ssg, lls): configuring and customizing a port, reading what a run could not handle, tracing a generated defect to the rule that produced it, bumping the engine pin, the local gate before a push, cross-platform rows, CI and caching, and driving sbt 2 with --client.
